description: Scan the local Decision Graph for uncovered components, weak rationales, contested decisions, and derived staleness. Schedulers should call with digest_only:true and treat actionable:false as a no-op.

digest_only.description: Hands-off mode. When healthy, return only the quiet actionable:false digest.

reference_systems.description: Pattern or design-system ids from Raven's existing registries. Omit for a small built-in pattern set.

use_cases.description: Use-case descriptions whose component terms should be covered by active decisions.

name: gap_scan
